title: Main pushes that change only task records skip the test shards
body: Evidence 2026-11-18: main pushes 8ba1baa and df1e3ee changed only tasks/*.json yet ran full CI (13 test shards): scripts/ci-changes.mjs sets test=false only for pull_request events and fails open on push. OpenClaw CI article (vincent.build/openclaw-ci-cost-reduction): stage checks by event; PRs run required checks, main pushes run small guards.

Outcome: a push to main whose changed files (before..after) are all tasks/<id>.json skips the test shards while lint/typecheck and the aggregate Check stay green; any other push, a force push, a missing before SHA or a detection error still fails open to full CI.
Proof: a ci-changes test feeds a push event with a tasks-only diff -> test=false, a mixed diff -> test=true, a zero/missing before SHA -> test=true.
